statBlock.name: Animated Armor
statBlock.description: An empty suit of armor carries out its creator’s orders.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft. It is Blind beyond that radius.
sections.Traits:
Antimagic Susceptibility. An Antimagic Field Incapacitates the armor while it is in the area. When targeted by Dispel Magic, it makes a Constitution save against the caster’s spell save DC. On a failure, it falls Unconscious for 1 minute.
False Appearance. While motionless, it passes for an ordinary suit of armor.
Constructed Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep. At 0 HP the magic animating it ends, leaving a badly damaged inanimate object.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

statBlock.name: Clay Golem
statBlock.description: An elemental spirit animates a clay guardian. Damage can break its obedience.

sections.Damage immunities: Acid, poison, psychic, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not adamantine.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Languages: Understands its creator's languages. It cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Acid Absorption. When it would take acid damage, it takes none and instead regains HP equal to that damage.
Berserk. At the start of each of its turns with 60 HP or less, roll 1d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each berserk turn, it attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is close enough to reach and attack, it attacks an object, favoring one smaller than itself. Being destroyed or returning to full HP ends the frenzy.
Immutable Form. Spells and other effects cannot change its form.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
Constructed Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 15 Constitution save or lose maximum HP equal to the damage taken. It dies if this reduction brings its maximum to 0. Greater Restoration or other magic can end the reduction.
Haste (Recharge 5–6). Until the end of its next turn, the golem magically gains +2 AC and advantage on Dexterity saves. It can make a Slam attack as a bonus action during this effect.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 167–168. Damage immunity wording follows the global errata.

statBlock.name: Flesh Golem
statBlock.description: A guardian sewn from body parts draws strength from lightning and recoils from fire.

sections.Damage immunities: Lightning, poison, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not adamantine.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Languages: Understands its creator's languages. It cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Berserk. At the start of each of its turns with 40 HP or less, roll 1d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each berserk turn, it attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is close enough to reach and attack, it attacks an object, favoring one smaller than itself. Being destroyed or returning to full HP ends the frenzy. The creator can spend an action to calm it with a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check while within 60 ft. and able to be heard. A success ends the frenzy. Further damage while at 40 HP or less can lead to another frenzy.
Aversion of Fire. Taking fire damage imposes disadvantage on its attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.
Lightning Absorption. When it would take lightning damage, it takes none and instead regains HP equal to that damage.
Immutable Form. Spells and other effects cannot change its form.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
Constructed Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 167 and 169. Damage immunity wording follows the global errata.

statBlock.name: Iron Golem
statBlock.description: A heavy iron guardian carries a massive blade and exhales clouds of poison.

sections.Damage immunities: Fire, poison, psychic, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not adamantine.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Languages: Understands its creator's languages. It cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Fire Absorption. When it would take fire damage, it takes none and instead regains HP equal to that damage.
Immutable Form. Spells and other effects cannot change its form.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
Constructed Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks, choosing from Slam and Sword.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
Sword. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 23 (3d10 + 7) slashing damage.
Poison Breath (Recharge 6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 19 Constitution save. It takes 45 (10d8) poison damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 167 and 170. Damage immunity wording follows the global errata.

statBlock.name: Stone Golem
statBlock.description: A carved stone guardian follows orders and can slow creatures that crowd it.

sections.Damage immunities: Poison, psychic, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not adamantine.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Languages: Understands its creator's languages. It cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. Spells and other effects cannot change its form.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
Constructed Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Slow (Recharge 5–6). Choose one or more visible creatures within 10 ft. Each makes a DC 17 Wisdom save against magic. On a failure, its speed is halved and it cannot take reactions. On its turn it can make at most one attack and can take either an action or a bonus action. The effects last for 1 minute. Each target can repeat its save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effects on a success.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 167 and 170. Damage immunity wording follows the global errata.

statBlock.name: Flying Sword
statBlock.description: A blade fights without a wielder and can pass for an ordinary sword.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft. It is Blind beyond that radius.
sections.Traits:
Antimagic Susceptibility. An Antimagic Field Incapacitates the sword while it is in the area. When targeted by Dispel Magic, it makes a Constitution save against the caster’s spell save DC. On a failure, it falls Unconscious for 1 minute.
False Appearance. While motionless and outside flight, it passes for an ordinary sword.
Constructed Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep. At 0 HP the magic animating it ends, leaving a badly damaged inanimate object.
sections.Actions: Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 19–20. Hover follows the official errata.

statBlock.name: Rug of Smothering
statBlock.description: An enchanted textile wraps around an intruder, pinning the victim and cutting off air.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft. It is Blind beyond that radius.
sections.Traits:
Antimagic Susceptibility. An Antimagic Field Incapacitates the rug while it is in the area. When targeted by Dispel Magic, it makes a Constitution save against the caster’s spell save DC. On a failure, it falls Unconscious for 1 minute.
Damage Transfer. While it grapples a creature, half of any damage dealt to the rug goes to that creature. The rug takes the remaining half.
False Appearance. While motionless, it passes for an ordinary rug.
Constructed Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep. At 0 HP the magic animating it ends, leaving a badly damaged inanimate object.
sections.Actions: Smother. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. On a hit, the rug Grapples the creature (escape DC 13). Until that grapple ends, the target is Restrained and Blinded and risks suffocation. The rug cannot Smother another creature during the grapple. The victim takes 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns.

statBlock.name: Shield Guardian
statBlock.description: A construct protects whoever wears its matching amulet and can release a stored spell when needed.

sections.Languages: Understands commands in any language. It cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Bound. While the guardian and amulet are on the same plane, the wearer can telepathically call the guardian to come to the amulet. The guardian knows the direction and distance to it. If the guardian is within 60 ft. of the wearer, it takes half of any damage dealt to the wearer, rounded up, in the wearer’s place.
Regeneration. At the start of its turn, it regains 10 HP if it has at least 1 HP.
Constructed Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Master’s amulet: The guardian has one linked amulet. The wearer can order it to attack or guard. Destroying the amulet Incapacitates the guardian until a replacement is made. An amulet can be targeted directly if nobody is wearing or carrying it. It has AC 10, 10 HP, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. Making a replacement takes 1 week and costs 1,000 gp in components.
sections.Spell Storing: A spellcaster wearing the amulet can cast a spell of 4th level or lower on the guardian. The spell is stored without taking effect. The guardian casts it when the wearer orders it to, or when a condition set by the caster occurs. The original caster sets the spell’s parameters, and the guardian needs no components. Casting empties the store. Storing a new spell replaces the previous one.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fist attacks.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Reactions: Shield. When a creature attacks the amulet wearer, the guardian can give the wearer +2 AC against that attack if the guardian is within 5 ft. of the wearer.
